info.title: surl-mcp
info.description: An MCP server whose tools let AI agents start, list and stop Surl protocol servers and see what their clients sent: Surl, the server-side mate of curl, served over standard input and output.

options.name: --allow-non-loopback
options.description: Let a listen URL name a host other than loopback

options.name: --log-level
options.description: Log each server at none, error, info, verbose or trace (default info)

options.name: --max-servers
options.description: Run at most <n> servers at once, 1 to 64 (default 8)

options.name: --root
options.description: Confine local paths to <dir> (else SURL_MCP_ROOT); with neither, no option may name a local path
